title: Builder's Dreams
description: Enough to make your house a home!
body:
## A standalone experience from [WorldShift](https://modrinth.com/modpack/worldshift)!

Welcome to a Minecraft experience focused on creativity, building, and making your world truly feel like home! 

Tired of living in a basic wooden box? This modpack gives you the tools to transform your ideas into reality. With 50 carefully selected mods, you'll find everything from new building blocks and decorative items to quality-of-life improvements and performance enhancements.

Create cozy cottages, modern houses, giant castles, detailed towns, or anything you can imagine. Expand your creativity with a wider selection of materials, improve your building experience, and enjoy a smoother Minecraft journey.

This pack focuses on:
-  More building blocks and decoration options
-  Furniture and details to bring builds to life
-  Extra ways to improve your surroundings
-  Performance and optimization improvements
-  Quality-of-life features to make building easier

Whether you're a builder, decorator, or just someone who wants a better-looking world, this modpack is made to help you create something amazing.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Start with a small home. End with a world worth remembering.
